subcategory: scroll animation system with smooth scrolling
use_cases: Creating smooth scroll-driven animations on any container or page element
Implementing parallax effects where elements move at different speeds based on scroll progress
Building reveal animations triggered when elements enter the viewport
Creating scroll-linked progress indicators and loading states
Adding sophisticated motion effects to landing pages and marketing sites
ai_summary: A comprehensive scroll animation system built on Lenis and Framer Motion that provides smooth scrolling with physics-based easing and scroll-triggered animations. The system includes React context for container-level scroll progress tracking, motion value transforms for parallax effects, and reusable hooks for integrating smooth scrolling into any React application.
